steps.label: TESTED FIRST
captions: Before the heart, a test: two gears, on bars set two spacings apart.
Our pick: the tighter one, 0.20 mm.

steps.label: VERSION 1
captions: Then the heart: 14 gears round the edge, and a knob in the middle.
Our first print turned, but one of the snap posts snapped.

steps.label: THE FIX, TESTED
captions: So each gear got its own pin, printed lying down so it flexes along its layers.
We tested three barb sizes. Number 3 felt best.

steps.label: VERSION 2
captions: ...and in the design file, all fifteen turn together. Nothing rubs.

steps.label: ON OUR PRINTER
captions: The real version 2 plate, fresh off our printer.

steps.label: ON OUR PRINTER
captions: The gears came out clean. The pins came loose, so they're printing again on their own.
Next: the whole heart, turning for real.
